today.q: How do you separate spatial associations from the causal effects of settlement status, such as formal versus informal areas?
outline: Acknowledge the difference between correlation and causation
Discuss settlement morphology and land-cover change variables
Propose methods to control for confounding socio-spatial factors
today.pitfall: Assuming settlement status directly causes specific ecological outcomes without causal proof.
today.follow_up: What unmeasured confounders might explain the observed ecosystem service bundles?
today.bring: Spatial statistical models or research design frameworks addressing causality.
